runs.goal: Explore the creator dashboard and open each form a creator can use, without submitting them. Finish when you have seen them.
requirements: R1. A creator can start a new draft from the dashboard.
R2. A draft has a title and a caption.
R3. Saving a draft keeps its title and caption. After a page reload, the saved values are still shown.
R4. A creator can schedule a post from the dashboard by giving a post title and a publish date.
R5. A publish date in the past must be rejected: the form shows a validation message and no post is scheduled. "Past" means before the studio date shown on the scheduling form.
